title: YouTube Comments - Text, Likes & Keyword Filters
description: Minimal input {"videoUrls": ["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw"], "maxResults": 3, "maxPagesPerSource": 1}. $0.002 per parsed page plus $0.0008 per delivered comment. Parsed empty/filtered pages are paid. No start fee; use maxTotalChargeUsd as a run option.

videoUrls.title: Video urls
videoUrls.description: Required YouTube video URLs or 11-character IDs, e.g. ["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw"]. Up to 20 videos; URLs and equivalent IDs deduplicate. Top-level comments only; reply text is not fetched. maxResults is shared across all videos.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the ENTIRE run after filters, deduplication and exclusions. Default 20; range 1–1000. Earlier targets can fill this cap. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in the Apify run options for a dollar cap; it is not an input field.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: "newest" (default) uses YouTube Newest ordering. Use "top" for requests for top, best or most popular comments. Both collect top-level comments only. Sort/bootstrap reads are included in the parsed-page price. Replies are not collected.

textContains.title: Text contains
textContains.description: Optional case-insensitive OR substring filter, e.g. ["pricing", "cost"]. Comments: matches comment text. Bing: matches title plus snippet. Empty disables. Filters run before maxResults; parsed-page fees apply, skipped rows are free.

minLikes.title: Min likes
minLikes.description: Minimum comment likes, e.g. 100. 0 disables. Missing counts fail a positive threshold. Rounded source labels such as 1.2K are approximate; inspect likes_approximate. Filters before maxResults. No extra filter fee.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Max pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Maximum successfully parsed result pages per query/video, default 2; range 1–20. Each page has a fee even if filters leave zero rows. Bootstrap/sort requests are included in that fee. This limits search depth, not a guarantee of enough matching results.

excludeIds.title: Exclude ids
excludeIds.description: Row id values from a previous dataset, e.g. [] on the first run. Up to 5,000 IDs. Skips matching IDs even if their content changed. Excluded rows have no row fee; parsed-page fees still apply. Keep IDs in your workflow; no history is stored automatically.

excludeContentHashes.title: Exclude content hashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior content_hash values, e.g. [] initially. Up to 5,000 SHA-256 values. Skips unchanged records while allowing changed prices/text/metrics through. Collection time, query, page position and images do not affect hashes. Caller-managed history; parsed-page fees apply.
